bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; providing for reallocation of an appropriation for Northern Lights Express passenger rail; requiring study of Minneapolis-Duluth intercity bus service; making a transfer; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; MINNEAPOLIS-DULUTH INTERCITY BUS STUDY. +]

[+(a) $....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation for a study on intercity bus service in the corridor between Minneapolis-St. Paul and Duluth. +]

[+(b) At a minimum, the study must: +]

[+(1) analyze existing demand and service levels for public transportation in the corridor; +]

[+(2) identify and evaluate alternatives for intercity bus service improvements, including estimation of: +]

[+(i) ridership; +]

[+(ii) capital and operating costs; and +]

[+(iii) revenue; +]

[+(3) consider barriers and risks; and +]

[+(4) make recommendations regarding feasibility of intercity bus service improvements. +]

[+(c) By February 1, 2026, the commissioner must submit a copy of the study to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over transportation finance and policy. +]

Sec. 2. [+APPROPRIATION CANCELLATION; NORTHERN LIGHTS EXPRESS. +]

[+The uncommitted balance of the appropriation in fiscal year 2024 under Laws 2023, chapter 68, article 1, section 2, subdivision 2, paragraph (d), for the Minneapolis-Duluth Northern Lights Express intercity passenger rail project, estimated to be $194,413,803, is canceled to the general fund on the effective date of this section. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]

Sec. 3. [+TRANSFER; HIGHWAY USER TAX DISTRIBUTION FUND. +]

[+(a) On the effective date of this section, the commissioner of transportation must calculate a transfer amount that equals the amount determined under section 2, less the amount appropriated under section 1. +]

[+(b) The amount calculated under paragraph (a) is transferred in fiscal year 2025 from the general fund to the highway user tax distribution fund. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; providing for reallocation of an appropriation for Northern Lights Express passenger rail; requiring study of Minneapolis-Duluth intercity bus service; making a transfer; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; MINNEAPOLIS-DULUTH INTERCITY BUS STUDY.

(a) $....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation for a study on intercity bus service in the corridor between Minneapolis-St. Paul and Duluth.

(b) At a minimum, the study must:

(1) analyze existing demand and service levels for public transportation in the corridor;

(2) identify and evaluate alternatives for intercity bus service improvements, including estimation of:

(i) ridership;

(ii) capital and operating costs; and

(iii) revenue;

(3) consider barriers and risks; and

(4) make recommendations regarding feasibility of intercity bus service improvements.

(c) By February 1, 2026, the commissioner must submit a copy of the study to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over transportation finance and policy.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION CANCELLATION; NORTHERN LIGHTS EXPRESS.

The uncommitted balance of the appropriation in fiscal year 2024 under Laws 2023, chapter 68, article 1, section 2, subdivision 2, paragraph (d), for the Minneapolis-Duluth Northern Lights Express intercity passenger rail project, estimated to be $194,413,803, is canceled to the general fund on the effective date of this section.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

Sec. 3. TRANSFER; HIGHWAY USER TAX DISTRIBUTION FUND.

(a) On the effective date of this section, the commissioner of transportation must calculate a transfer amount that equals the amount determined under section 2, less the amount appropriated under section 1.

(b) The amount calculated under paragraph (a) is transferred in fiscal year 2025 from the general fund to the highway user tax distribution fund.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
